feeds.title: ESPNcricinfo » Cricket
feeds.description: Explore the latest updates, information, schedule, and news on Cricket. Get expert updates on Cricket matches, upcoming cricket series squads and team updates at ESPNcricinfo. ESPNcricinfo, a wholly owned subsidiary of ESPN Inc., is the world's leading cricket website where fans can access live ball-by-ball coverage of all international cricket matches, catch news and features written by some of the world's best cricket writers, and get in-depth statistics for every first class and international match ever played.
